QuestInfo.name: [Valentine's Day] The Sweetest Day
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to give out chocolates to people all over Maple World for Valentine's Day. Sounds like fun... if you get some too!
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra wants to give out chocolates to people all over Maple World for Valentine's Day. Sounds like fun... if you get some too!
QuestInfo.2: You can almost taste that chocolate... But first hunt some normal monsters, collect 100 chocolates, and bring them to Cassandra to receive 1 Renegade Coin.

But you can help, right? Get me 100 #r#i3994500##t3994500##k to share with everybody, and I'll even share some with YOU!

no.0: Pfft, not sweet at all... Let me know if you change your mind!

yes.0: Monsters always have a great supply of Sweet Chocolates this time of year. 100, and I'll give you one #i2435093##r#t2435093##k and ten #i2001506##r#t2001506##ks. Oh, and #bmonsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you won't have chocolates#k! They get cavities.
